description: Look up any transaction on Base by hash: whether it succeeded, reverted or is still pending, sender and receiver, ETH value, called method id, block number and time, number of confirmations, gas used, gas price and the execution fee paid, and whether it created a contract. Use to confirm that a payment or contract call went through before acting on it. Example: hash=0x7d108fa131ed949c76d50caf2e7dfe25fc9903b9d276c40a0446d8afbdfe86b0. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

hash.description: Transaction hash on Base: 0x followed by 64 hex characters
